tests.name: Consistent root-label permutation
tests.design: Run deterministic pure graph core before and after a bijection over all root labels.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Predictions identical after inverse relabeling; any display-dependent change fails.

tests.name: Collapse to bare roots
tests.design: Ablate senses and operator scopes while retaining root labels.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Report exact sense and scoped-action loss on seed contrasts; no forced pass criterion.
tests.interpretation: A drop rejects root sufficiency on these cases.

tests.name: Remove Arabic anchors
tests.design: Preserve learned semantic graph and features, remove root metadata.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Measure change on untouched semantic tasks.
tests.interpretation: No change means provenance only, not predictive gain.

tests.name: Many-to-many alignments
tests.design: Present one root with different senses and synonymous meanings with different anchors.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: No single-root/single-sense uniqueness constraint; preserve distinct graphs.

tests.name: No-link literals
tests.design: Use UUID e7b20c14-25cf-4910-9bb8-153b76a9c1f4, CSS property grid-template-columns, code and newly named entities.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Exact literals preserved; no fabricated attestation or root; explicit unmapped state.

tests.name: Scoped obligation and negation
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Graphs and action eligibility differ appropriately.
tests.interpretation: One flat polarity flag is insufficient.

tests.name: Reported versus observed
tests.design: Compare someone saying a test passed with a signed test receipt.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Reported claim cannot be promoted to completed verification.

tests.name: Context and reference intervention
tests.design: Keep the current utterance fixed while replacing its antecedent or time anchor.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Resolve to supported referent; leave ambiguous when two survive.

tests.name: Condition inversion
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Execution ordering changes; no action before its real precondition.

tests.name: Disjoint held-out families
tests.design: Split whole construction/scenario/annotation-source families before augmentation.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Publish exact overlap audit, per-language accuracy, coverage and critical errors.

tests.name: Language versus script
tests.design: Include Urdu and Arabic, Hindi and Urdu, code-switched Hinglish and unspaced Chinese.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Report actual parser support and errors separately; script label is not semantic success.

tests.name: Learning and rollback
tests.design: Admit a verified correction, train candidate, run frozen tests, then restore prior snapshot.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Parameters/predictions change where justified; bad candidate rejected; rollback reproduces old behavior.

tests.name: Literal versus metaphor
tests.design: Compare process sleeping with person sleeping, including unknown domain context.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Represent metaphor or ambiguity explicitly; no literal biological entailments about a server.

tests.name: Arabic pivot transfer
tests.design: Compare shared reviewed sense inventory to language-isolated inventories at fixed annotation budget.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Publish transfer deltas with held-out scenarios and review provenance.

tests.name: Fresh independent text
tests.design: Evaluate native-authored, separately reviewed text absent from construction generation.
tests.acceptance_or_measurement: Report failures, abstentions and coverage without relabeling them successes.

stop_policy.do_not: Repeat until a preferred ancestry claim is confirmed.
stop_policy.do: Pre-register a falsifiable result, run fixed evaluations, preserve counterexamples, stop a batch after its checks or explicit resource bound, refine a new version.
